# Microsoft Graph changelog / M365 Copilot — captured 2026-08-14

## Graph changelog RSS — REGRESSED THIS SCAN
Source used: https://developer.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/changelog/rss/
(the HTML changelog at developer.microsoft.com/graph/changelog/ still renders navigation chrome only)

The feed's **lastBuildDate is August 14, 2026**, but its newest ITEMS are dated **June 19, 2026**
(cross-tenant migration job validation; DLP action/notification updates; tasks-and-plans history
tracking resources). On the 2026-08-10 scan this same feed carried an **August 10, 2026** item
(`crossTenantMigrationJob` gains `migrate`). The feed has therefore gone BACKWARDS — the August items
are no longer present.

Treat the Graph RSS feed as unreliable for recency, not as evidence that nothing shipped. No Graph
finding either way this scan: the June items are generic Graph churn (identity, security, files,
teamwork, backup) with **no Copilot, agent, AI or bot content**.

## M365 admin center What's New (whats-new-in-preview) — stale source
ms.date 2026-08-11, updated_at 2026-08-11, but the newest CONTENT section is **November 2025**
(Engineering direct renamed to Enhanced Engagements). Everything AI-related on the page is old:
June 2025 Copilot Search admin experience, April 2025 Copilot network connectivity test, February
2025 admin-initiated Copilot feedback, January 2025 **AI Administrator role**. The page's date
metadata moves without its content moving — it cannot be used for change detection.

## Cross-reference
The live M365 Copilot agent-governance surface is NOT on either page above. It is the Agent 365
registry (`/microsoft-365/admin/manage/agent-registry`) and the Package Management API
(`/microsoft-365-copilot/extensibility/api/admin-settings/package/overview`), both reported
2026-08-10. Neither is in sources.json.

Nothing reported for Microsoft Copilot (M365) this scan.

Updated: 2026-08-14 — no new content; Graph RSS regressed from August back to June.
